lines.en: I move slowly through the air.

lines.zh: 我的身体半透明，看不真切。
lines.en: My body is half-transparent, hard to fix on.
I come around the altar's edge.
When I move, the light bends.
I don't land; I travel suspended.
There are no feet under my hem.
I slide along the rock wall.
I drift while watching you.
I turn and my shape scatters.
I emerge from behind the pillar.
I drift into the dark before stopping.
I drift sideways to the other side.
I make no sound, only the air moves.
I hover overhead and look down.
I withdraw, my form fading a shade.
I raise a hand and point at you.
I hang there, sleeves hanging.
I was born of a sacrifice.

lines.zh: 那些地底的信徒给了我这副样子。
lines.en: The underground cultists gave me this form.

lines.zh: 我在半透明与实体之间。
lines.en: I hover between translucent and solid.
My face isn't quite a face.
The light in the cave is cold.
I wait for someone to look up.
This body has no need to breathe.
I count my own fingers.

lines.zh: 这块地方，本来是他们的。
lines.en: This place was theirs.
My fingers uncurl one by one.
I come near, then withdraw.
You stare at me; I stare back.
Can you see me clearly?
My shape unsettles you.
I know the gem in your hand.
You're standing on the altar.
When you can't move, don't panic.
No rush. Look your fill.
I laid this dark.
Your eyes keep sliding away.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，你就动不了。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, you won't move.
I scatter, then re-form.
My form thins by a layer.
I withdraw into the pillar's shadow.
My shape shivered for a long while.
One of my fingers has come apart.
I don't cry out. I have no throat.
I look at the tear in myself.
I mend myself slowly.
You can actually hit a wraith.
I'll remember that.
Food is of no use to me.
You hold it up; I only look at you.

lines.zh: 它连我的影子都碰不到。
lines.en: It cannot even touch my shadow.
Put it away. I don't need it.
I fill myself with something else.

lines.zh: 你在用食物对付一个虚影？
lines.en: Food against a wraith?
My fingers pass through it.
Keep that little thing for yourself.
I'm not hungry. I never am.
Such small tricks do nothing to me.
You hit me and pass halfway through.

lines.zh: 我没有实体，也没有温度。
lines.en: I have no substance and no warmth.
You stagger back; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的袖子，手一凉。
lines.en: You touch my sleeve; your hand goes cold.
I withdraw, my form scattering.
I stay where I am; you step aside.

lines.zh: 你的手从我脸上滑过去。
lines.en: Your hand slides through my face.
I gather myself again.
Your vision is blurring, isn't it?
Touch me again and I'll lock you.
Another wraith is on the altar.
We pass through each other.
It's fainter than I am.
Two shadows hang side by side.
We share the same patch of dark.
It points at the people below.
We part, each keeping a side.
It half-scatters, then re-forms.
This place doesn't need more wraiths.

lines.zh: 下次献祭，我们会同时出现。
lines.en: At the next sacrifice, we appear together.
I open my hand and it floats up.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的手指，又停住。
lines.en: It passes through my fingers and stops.
This pearl is very cold.
I suspend it above my palm.
I needn't carry it.
It falls into my shadow.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我都能拿。
lines.en: I can take whatever falls.
It cools slowly in my palm.
I press it into a crack in the stone.
That little thing is mine now.
You've stepped into the altar's ground.
My hand hangs above your head.
Your feet won't move.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手里的东西也放不下。
lines.en: Now you can't even put that down.
I've locked your motion.
All you can do is watch.
Time in this cave belongs to me.
You're in my dark.
A sacrifice never needs consent.
I close in inch by inch.
You're still there, not one step.
I drift a full circle around you.
I wait for the binding to pass.
Those with you ran.
I never let your hands out of sight.
You can't even swing the sword.
I come from the front, not hiding.

lines.zh: 我的形状在你眼里变形了。
lines.en: My shape distorts in your eyes.
You can still blink.
The binding is almost complete.
My palm presses over your heart.

lines.zh: 这一下没有伤口，只有冷。
lines.en: No wound — only cold.
You're shoved backward bodily.
My hand reaches through your armor seam.
I raise my hand as slowly as water.
Bound, you can only take it.
That left your ears ringing.
I withdraw and my form gathers.
You don't bleed, yet you can't stand.
I raise my hand again.
The altar flares, and I take shape.
Someone has made an offering.

lines.zh: 我从蛾的影子里升起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a moth's shadow.
A thin mist gathers in the cave.
My face slowly resolves.
The cultists draw back to either side.
First I look at the altar.
At last, someone has filled this dark.
I rise two feet off the ground.
I hear a living thing breathing.

lines.zh: 火穿过我，只留下一圈热。
lines.en: Fire passes through me, leaving only warmth.
I drop and scatter into shadow.
Water passes through me.
The blast thins me out.
The arrow goes through my chest.
Another spell pins me.
Without offerings, I fade.
The flash nearly erases me.

lines.zh: 我一直往下沉，没人看得见。
lines.en: I sink, and no one sees.
